name: BytePlus Cloud Sandbox
description: VeFaaS cloud sandbox backend for OpenClaw agents. Commands run via BytePlus API Gateway HTTP endpoint — no SSH or VPC configuration needed.

sandboxId.description: VeFaaS sandbox instance ID (faasInstanceName). Omit to auto-create using functionId + credentials.

workdir.description: Working directory inside the sandbox. Default: /home/gem

token.description: Optional Bearer token for API Gateway authentication.

functionId.description: VeFaaS function ID for auto-creating sandbox instances.

timeoutMin.description: Sandbox instance timeout in minutes. Default: 60.

region.description: BytePlus region for VeFaaS API. Default: ap-southeast-1.

functionId.label: VeFaaS Function ID
functionId.help: VeFaaS function ID for auto-creating sandbox instances.

region.label: Region
region.help: BytePlus region for VeFaaS API. Default: ap-southeast-1.
